pages.title: Icelandic
pages.text: A short, shaggy, cold-hardy pony from Iceland, known for an unusually smooth extra gait.

pages.title: Sure-Footed
pages.text:
Bred on scree and lava fields, an Icelandic **takes no fall damage at all from under 12 blocks** - and neither does its rider, since a horse absorbs the landing for both of you.

Past twelve blocks it falls like anything else. This is footing, not flight.
